instance.finding_key: packages/notes/src/view/list-empty-bullet-plugin.ts::`getrulefn` reads markdown-it's private `__rules__` registry and throws at module-import time, so a markdown-it upgrade takes down the whole notes preview rather than degrading one rendering case

finding.summary: `getRuleFn` reads markdown-it's private `__rules__` registry and throws at module-import time, so a markdown-it upgrade takes down the whole notes preview rather than degrading one rendering case
finding.evidence: `const rule = ruler.__rules__.find((r) => r.name === name);` / `if (!rule) throw new Error(...)` at list-empty-bullet-plugin.ts:211-212, reached from `listEmptyBulletPlugin` (:179) which `preview.ts` invokes via `md.use(listEmptyBulletPlugin)` at module scope (preview.ts:47, alongside the module-level `const md = new MarkdownIt(...)` at preview.ts:12). Because the `md.use(...)` calls run during module evaluation, this `throw` is not a rendering fallback — it is an import-time crash of `preview.ts` and therefore of every consumer that imports `NotePreview`. `__rules__` is not part of markdown-it's public API (the file's own comment at :203 concedes `markdown-it's Ruler exposes no public getter`), and the copied `lheadingRule` is likewise pinned to 14.x internals (`state.skipChars`, `state.getLines`, `getRules('paragraph')`). Any dependency bump that renames the private field converts a cosmetic markdown deviation into a blank notes pane for all consumers. Fix belongs on the new code: recover the stock rule without private access (e.g. import `markdown-it/lib/rules_block/list`, or degrade gracefully instead of throwing).
